text:
Fiona: Found a glorious toasted marshmallow on a stick behind the microwave. Who brought the ritual snack? :marshmallow:
Omar: That is the Marshmallow Scepter. It's been passed down since the Great Snack Shortage of 2023. :crown:
Leah: Wait therewas a Great Snack Shortage? I thought that was a myth. :eyes:
Ben: Myth confirmed. Also proposal: every sprint ship we do a 5-second Scepter Toast. Low toxicity, high morale. :tada:
Fiona: Rules draft: 1) No actual fire indoors 2) Scepter may be a fork-wrapped treat or a plush replica 3) Photo evidence required for lore credits
Omar: We need a ceremonial line: "May our builds be green and our snacks be plentiful." Simple and theatrical. :drum:
Leah: Also adding a tiny honor: the Scepter Bearer gets to pin a silly emoji to their Slack name for 24h. Suggestions? :sparkles:
Ben: Suggestion: :toasty_scepter: (if someone makes an emoji). If not, temporary nickname. Also Scepter Bearer must bring one bag of mini marshmallows the next day. :marshmallow:
PlantBot: Suggestion logged: "Marshmallow Scepter tradition". Reminder set for Friday sprint demo. (PlantBot)
Fiona: Who's brave enough to take the first oath at Friday demo? I volunteer if we use a plush replica. No skewers near laptops. :laughing:
Omar: I'll make a quick mock of a plush scepter and a tiny badge. Low-effort, cute, keeps hands safe.
Leah: Can we add a one-line to the handbook culture page: "The Marshmallow Scepter: a tiny ritual to celebrate small wins"? Keeps lore discoverable.
Ben: Love it. I'll order stickers with a tiny scepter drawing too. Bonus points for someone who makes a tiny victory hat.
Fiona: OK ceremony planned. PlantBot will prod us on Friday. Remote folks can upload a 5s video of their toast. May the scepter bless our merges. :crossed_fingers:
